title: ACL Grant 0.2 — payload
description: Add a subject to an access-control list. The entry states its act scope explicitly (`act`), and may carry an approve scope, a narrowed or additive capability set, and the capabilities it may approve. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

entry.description: The AclEntry the producer wants the maintainer to hold for the subject (intent). `act`, `keys` and `capabilities` are REQUIRED and explicit; `approve` and `approveCapabilities` are optional, and absent means none. Maintainer-populated members (`createdAt`, `createdBy`, `updatedAt`, `updatedBy`, `delegatedBy`) are ignored if a producer supplies them; the response carries the realized entry.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale, recorded with the grant.

Response.title: ACL Grant 0.2 — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/grant/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/grant/0.2#response.

entry.description: The canonical AclEntry the maintainer now holds for the subject, including the maintainer-populated provenance (`createdAt`, `createdBy`, `delegatedBy`).
